description: Cost-of-capital engine. Compute WACC, cost of equity (CAPM), cost of debt, unlevered/relevered beta, and country or size premiums from an explicit capital structure and market inputs. Use this to derive the discount rate an income-approach valuation needs; it returns a rate, not a valuation, so feed the result to calculate_dcf, or to calculate_residual for IFRS-basis measurement. Methods: wacc: equity_weight, debt_weight, cost_equity, cost_debt, tax_rate; capm: risk_free, beta, market_return; startup_capm: risk_free, beta, market_risk_premium, size_premium, illiquidity_premium; build_up: risk_free, equity_risk_premium, size_premium, industry_premium, specific_premium; currency_adjusted: base_rate, currency_risk_premium, country_risk_premium; country_risk: sovereign_yield, us_risk_free; esg: base_rate, esg_risk_premium, esg_opportunity_discount; portfolio_beta: weights, betas; ibr: risk_free, credit_spread, tenor_years. Supply exactly one method with its declared inputs (no defaults). An unknown method, a missing input, or an extra field returns an error envelope (code INVALID_ARGUMENT) instead of raising.

cost_debt.description: Pre-tax cost of debt as a decimal.

cost_equity.description: Cost of equity as a decimal (0.12 = 12%).

credit_spread.description: Credit spread over the risk-free rate (decimal).

debt_weight.description: Market-value weight of debt (decimal); with equity_weight must sum to 1.

equity_weight.description: Market-value weight of equity (decimal); with debt_weight must sum to 1.

esg_opportunity_discount.description: ESG opportunity discount subtracted from the base rate (decimal).

esg_risk_premium.description: ESG risk premium added to the base rate (decimal).

method.description: Formula to apply; the tool description lists the exact inputs each value requires.

tax_rate.description: Marginal corporate tax rate as a decimal.

name: calculate_discount_rate

outputSchema.description: Shared result envelope returned by every tool.

assumptions.description: Inputs and assumptions used, echoed for traceability.

data_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the underlying data, when fetched.

error.description: Error detail, present only when status='error'.

formula_ref.description: Formula or standards reference for the method.

method.description: Method or tool name that produced the result.

steps.description: Ordered computation steps, when the method reports them.

ticker.description: Ticker the result pertains to, when applicable.

value.description: Primary result: a number for scalar methods, an object for valuation methods.

title: Cost of capital and discount rates
